name: ArkHook
mechanic: Charges a configurable buy/sell fee on each swap and routes it to a fee router.
plain: Takes a configurable fee from the output of every buy and sell, pulls it from the pool manager and forwards it to an external fee router. Can also trigger onchain maintenance like a buyback after a swap.
rules: Every buy and sell pays a configurable fee, skimmed from the output.
Collected fees route to an external fee router set by the owner.
